title: "ctDNA sampling by randomized group"
format: html
execute:
  warning: false

---

- Descriptive; not prespecified in the SAP.
- Sampled: at least one sample date recorded (attempted sample).

```{r}
#| label: setup

library(here)
library(arrow)
library(knitr)
library(tidyverse)

results_dir <- here("analysis", "10-implementation", "results")
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| label: read-data

cohort <- read_parquet(
  here("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-cohort.parquet")
)
samples <- read_parquet(
  here("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-ctdna-samples.parquet")
)

if (any(!samples$id %in% cohort$id)) {
  stop("ctDNA samples contain a patient absent from the cohort dataset.")
}
```

## Patient-level sampling

```{r}
#| label: patient-sampling

patient_samples <- samples |>
  group_by(id) |>
  summarise(
    n_attempted_samples = sum(attempted_sample %in% TRUE),
    has_valid_sample = any(valid_ctdna_result %in% TRUE),
    has_mutation_positive_sample = any(
      attempted_sample %in% TRUE &
        valid_ctdna_result %in% TRUE &
        !is.na(n_mut) &
        n_mut > 0
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Patients without any sample count as not sampled.
patient_data <- cohort |>
  select(id, tx) |>
  left_join(patient_samples, by = "id") |>
  mutate(
    n_attempted_samples = replace_na(n_attempted_samples, 0L),
    has_valid_sample = replace_na(has_valid_sample, FALSE),
    has_mutation_positive_sample = replace_na(
      has_mutation_positive_sample,
      FALSE
    ),
    randomized_group = case_when(
      tx == 0L ~ "Usual care",
      tx == 1L ~ "ctDNA"
    )
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(randomized_group))
```

## Summary by randomized group

```{r}
#| label: sampling-summary

sampling_summary <- patient_data |>
  group_by(randomized_group) |>
  summarise(
    randomized_patients = n(),
    patients_sampled = sum(n_attempted_samples > 0L),
    sampled_percent = 100 * patients_sampled / randomized_patients,
    attempted_samples = sum(n_attempted_samples),
    patients_with_valid_sample = sum(has_valid_sample),
    patients_with_mutation_positive_sample = sum(has_mutation_positive_sample),
    mutation_positive_percent_of_valid = if_else(
      patients_with_valid_sample == 0L,
      NA_real_,
      100 * patients_with_mutation_positive_sample / patients_with_valid_sample
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_parquet(
  sampling_summary,
  file.path(results_dir, "ctdna-sampling-by-group.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: ctdna-sampling-summary
#| tbl-cap: "Patients sampled and mutation-positive by randomized group"
#| echo: false

kable(sampling_summary)
```
